summary: Stripe subscription billing hardening evidence for checkout, webhook idempotency, subscription status visibility, failed-payment handling and entitlement safety. Static evidence is complete for this PR; paid production enablement still depends on the Stripe Runtime Proof and required CI checks passing on the final merge candidate.
productionGate: Stripe paid billing remains gated by required CI and Stripe Runtime Proof status checks before accepting real payments.
controlsVerified: Checkout URL host is validated before returning a redirect target to the browser.
Checkout creates Stripe sessions only after auth, active organization context, manage_billing RBAC, trusted mutation validation, rate limiting and step-up verification.
Checkout tests use the allowed Stripe checkout host so the host guard is exercised without false 502 failures.
Billing context fetches the latest subscription row without hiding past_due, unpaid or incomplete status from callers.
Billing context grants paid entitlement plan only for active or trialing subscription status and otherwise falls back to starter while preserving status.
Failed payment webhook coverage verifies no subscription entitlement upsert happens on invoice.payment_failed.
Failed payment webhook fixture returns array-shaped subscription query data matching the handler's subscriptions?.[0] access pattern.
Runtime evidence redacts secrets and does not include customer data.
testsAddedOrExpanded: src/server/queries/billing.test.ts: active subscription grants normalized plan, past_due preserves status without paid entitlements, and missing subscription falls back to starter
src/server/billing/stripe-webhooks.test.ts: failed payment wave sends billing email/audit and does not upsert entitlements
src/app/api/billing/checkout/route.test.ts: checkout happy path uses checkout.stripe.com fixture accepted by host guard
tests/security/billing-checkout-hardening.test.ts: checkout hardening happy paths use checkout.stripe.com fixture accepted by host guard
